scheme1_name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child (SGC)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Financial aid for meritorious single girl children to continue studies in classes 11-12
comparisons.scheme2_value: Credit facility for farmers to meet short-term and long-term agricultural needs

comparisons.scheme1_value: Only single girl children (includes twins/all girls born together) with 70%+ marks in CBSE class 10, studying in CBSE-affiliated schools
comparisons.scheme2_value: Individual farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, or farmer groups (SHGs/JLGs) of any gender

comparisons.scheme1_value: Rs. 1,000/month for maximum 24 months (Rs. 24,000 total during classes 11-12)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Credit loan at ~4% interest per annum (after 2% subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive); limit increases yearly up to 5 years

comparisons.scheme1_value: Family income ≤ Rs. 8,00,000/year; school tuition fee ≤ Rs. 2,500/month (class 10) or ≤ Rs. 3,000/month (classes 11-12)
comparisons.scheme2_value: No income ceiling mentioned; applicants must have cultivable land

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar, class 10 mark sheet, school admission proof, income affidavit (on Rs. 50 stamp paper, attested by officer), passport photo, bank details, fee receipt
comparisons.scheme2_value: ID proof (Aadhaar/Driving License/Voter ID), address proof, land holding certificate from revenue authority, cropping pattern, bank application form, photos

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online only via cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html; fill form with class 10 roll number, upload scanned undertaking and affidavit (max 1 MB PDFs)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Hybrid: online via Jan Samarth portal or directly at your bank branch; fill form and submit; bank contacts within 3-4 working days

comparisons.scheme1_value: Fixed yearly windows notified on CBSE scholarship page—check current session dates
comparisons.scheme2_value: No fixed deadline; apply any time during the year

comparisons.scheme1_value: Not specified in guidelines; school verification is mandatory
comparisons.scheme2_value: Bank contact within 3-4 working days; final sanction at branch (varies by bank)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Tuition fee caps are strict—exceeding Rs. 2,500/month (class 10) or Rs. 3,000/month (11-12) = ineligible. Income limit Rs. 8 lakh/year strictly enforced via attested affidavit. Mandatory school verification, good conduct, and regular attendance required.
comparisons.scheme2_value: If payment is late, you lose 3% prompt repayment incentive, making loan costlier. Loans above Rs. 1.60 lakh (or Rs. 3.00 lakh) may require collateral security. Banks have discretion to vary terms by location.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Renewable in class 12 if class 11 marks meet criteria; must maintain attendance and conduct
comparisons.scheme2_value: Credit limit increases 10% every year up to 5 years; card can be used continuously with timely repayment

comparisons.scheme1_value: Direct transfer via ECS/NEFT to Aadhaar-linked bank account
comparisons.scheme2_value: RuPay/ATM-enabled card; usable at ATMs, micro-ATMs, PoS at input dealers, and via mobile banking
